newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-PITMAN WINS FIRST IRISH NATIONAL WITH MUDAHIM.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-PITMAN WINS FIRST IRISH NATIONAL WITH MUDAHIM.

text.p: British trainer Jenny Pitman saddled her first winner of the Irish Grand National when Mudahim won at Fairyhouse on Monday.
Pitman's 13-2 chance, ridden by Ireland's Jason Titley, edged out Arthur Moore's 14-1 shot Amble Speedy by a short head after a dramatic finish to the three miles five furlongs (5.8 km) race.
Gordon Richards-trained 9-2 favourite The Grey Monk finished a further 11 lengths further back in third place.
